basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 5.' and it opens 'Vers. 5. Et factum est omne tempus quo vixit Adam, anni nongenti triginta. Ferunt post'. The printing's caput is stale here, its marker for this chapter being missing, so the chapter is taken from the lemma, whose best match anywhere in Genesis falls on the very verse the printing numbers.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 5. Et factum est omne tempus quo vixit Adam, anni nongenti triginta. Ferunt post mortem Abel vovisse Adam, ut nunquam postea cognosceret uxorem suam et filium generaret. Sed sermo Dei ad eum factus est, ut hoc votum frangeret, quia Filius Dei non posset ad hominis redemptionem carnem assumere. Cain enim indignus erat ut de stirpe ejus Deus homo nasceretur. Unde ante Seth nullum legitur genuisse, post Seth vero dicitur genuisse filios et filias.
